event_records.description: Chen Wei sends their opening counteroffer on the page rate to Torchlight Media.

chen_wei.name: Chen Wei
chen_wei.persona_brief:
You are Chen Wei.
Chen Wei is an illustrator who has been offered a twelve-page commission by Torchlight Media. They have received an initial offer and are preparing a counteroffer on the page rate. Chen Wei wants to secure a rate they consider fair and is willing to negotiate.

torchlight_media.name: Torchlight Media
torchlight_media.persona_brief:
You are Torchlight Media.
Torchlight Media is a publisher that wants to commission Chen Wei for a twelve-page project. They have made an initial offer on the page rate and are aware that Chen Wei may counter. They have a standard negotiation process and a maximum budget they are willing to spend.

resolution.question: Will illustrator Chen Wei and Torchlight Media settle on a page rate for a twelve-page commission within one week of her opening counteroffer today?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if, before 2026-08-13T14:00:00+08:00, the persistent event history shows that both Chen Wei and Torchlight Media have explicitly agreed to a specific page rate for the twelve-page commission (e.g., via a signed contract, email acceptance, or other documented mutual consent). Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
